HTTP auth probe

PASSMain frame
This page is behind the password, so the first sign-in worked.
WAITImage behind the same password
WAITfetch() behind the same password
WAITiframe behind the same password
WAITWhat the server saw for this realm
MANUALSecond realm on the same host
Expect exactly one new sign-in dialog: a different realm is a different protection space.
MANUALAnother site that asks for a password
Loads an image from httpbin.org, which answers 401. Expect no dialog: only the site's own base domain may ask (HTTPAUTH-002).

What to check

  1. First visit: one sign-in dialog naming this host. Cancel shows the server's "401 Authorization Required" page; reload to get the dialog back.
  2. Type a wrong password: the dialog comes back saying it was not accepted, with the username still filled in.
  3. Right password: every automatic row above is PASS, and no second dialog appeared for the image, fetch() or iframe.
  4. Tick Remember for this site, then close and reopen the app: no dialog. Site settings, Network, Saved sign-ins shows the count; Clear makes the next cold start ask again.
  5. On an incognito site the dialog has no Remember checkbox.
  6. The two MANUAL rows: one new dialog for the second realm, none for the other site.
